sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Now I can see it clearly! The loose reds have appeared inside the notches (the recesses)!
Row 35: SSSSSSSWWWRRRWWWWWWWWWRR → columns 28-34 S, 35-37 W, 38-40 R, 41-49 W, 50-51 R.
So: the notches are at columns 38-40, rows 35-37 and 41-43, and the reds are visible inside them! The notches are holding the reds (the reds were "picked up" — they're now at the notch positions, and the notch positions moved along with the player!).
Wait — did the reds move along with the player, or did the notches just happen to align with the stationary reds? The player moved RIGHT×2 (left edge 29→35). If the reds are stationary at 38-40, then the notches (left+3..left+5 = 38-40) align with them. If the reds are being carried, they should also be at 38-40 (since they were hidden under the body at 38-40 before the move… no wait, before the move the body was at 29-43, and the reds were hidden under the W at 38-40).
Hmm, before the move (left=29): the notches were at 32-34, and the reds were hidden under the body's W at 38-40. After the move (left=35): the notches are at 38-40, and the reds are visible there.
If the reds were stationary: they were at 38-40 the whole time, hidden under the body, and now they're visible through the notches. ✓ Consistent.
If the reds were being carried (picked up when the body covered them): they should have been at the notch positions 32-34 before the move, and at 38-40 after the move. Also consistent!
To distinguish: check the previous frame (left=29): were the reds at 32-34 (carried) or hidden (stationary)? From the earlier output at left=29: row 35: 'SSSWWWSSSWWWWWWWWWRRRNNNSSSSSSSSSS' → S at 32-34 (notch, empty), W at 35-42 (covering 38-40). So at left=29, the notches (32-34) were empty, and the reds were hidden under the W at 38-40.
If the reds had been picked up by the notches, they should have been visible at 32-34 at left=29. They weren't. So the reds are stationary, and the notches are just passing over them.
Hmm wait, but when did the reds become "hidden under the body"? Originally the reds were at 38-40, and the body was far to the right. When the body moved left over 38-40 (during LEFT×4), the reds got covered. So the reds are stationary, and they're now visible through the notches.
So the notches aren't carrying anything. The reds are stationary at 38-40, rows 35-37/41-43.
Current state (left=35, top=32, feet on the right):
- Notches: 38-40, rows 35-37/41-43 (the reds are visible inside them).
- Feet: 50-52, rows 35-37/41-43 (right side of the box).
- Body: 35-49.
Level not complete.
Hmm. So what's the win condition? Let me think…
The reds are visible inside the notches. The feet are outside the box.
Maybe the win condition: the reds (inside the notches) need to be delivered to the hollow (the empty space) → notches at 44-46 → left = 41. Then the reds would be at 44-46, rows 35-37/41-43 — inside the hollow (visible through the notches, which are over the hollow).
Let me try RIGHT×2 (left 35→41): notches at 44-46 (over the hollow), feet at 53-55.
If the level completes → win condition = delivering the reds (through the notches) to the hollow.
If it doesn't complete → reconsider.
No wait, actually, hmm: maybe the win condition is that the reds need to be inside the hollow, and the notches are just a window. When the notches are over the hollow, the reds (stationary at 38-40) won't be at 44-46. So "reds inside the hollow" is impossible unless the reds move.
Unless the reds get picked up when the notches align! That is, when the notches are exactly over the reds (left=35), the reds get picked up (attached to the notches), and then moving right carries them into the hollow!
That's the classic mechanic: pick up with the hands (notches), carry, and drop into the box.
The evidence so far is consistent with both interpretations, but the "pickup" interpretation is a more natural game design. Test: RIGHT×2. After the move, check whether the reds are at 44-46 (carried) or still at 38-40 (stationary, hidden under the W).
Let me execute RIGHT×2 and check the R positions.

sections.content: I've confirmed the reds are stationary at 38-40, not carried by the notches. Now I'll test if they get picked up when the notches align over the hollow by moving right twice and checking their final position.
